title: Haddock coconut curry
summary: Haddock coconut curry is a indian dinner built around haddock fillets and light coconut milk, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Haddock coconut curry. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add haddock fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and light coconut milk.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until cauliflower is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Haddock coconut curry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Haddock coconut curry.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
